description: Intraday available capacity at auction opening - between Belgium and United Kingdom is a dataset listed in Elia open data platform, an open data platform of a transmission system operator, published or maintained by Elia Group. Intraday available transfer capacity at auction opening for energy exchanges between Elia and the United-Kingdom transmission system operators (TSOs) for imports and exports across Belgiums borders. They are only available for the UK border. Coverage: Belgium. The portal flags it as a time series. The portal files it under Transmission. Its keywords are Capacity, Availibility, Intraday, EU Reg. No 534/2013. The portal shows 2025-06-26 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Elia Open Data Licence (/pages/licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support network planning and operations studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-elia-open-data-portal.
